name: Jonas Kett

Jonas Kett (LN) — Managing Director

Jonas is a former royal army quartermaster who built his reputation organizing military supply trains during the War of Broken Banners. A meticulous and demanding businessman, he believes that reliable transportation is the foundation upon which the frontier's prosperity must be built. Kett maintains that the company's considerable privileges are justified by the expense and danger of constructing roads through unsettled territory. Nevertheless, he has little patience for independent competitors who threaten the Overland's commercial interests.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 41 (source excerpt; may be partial)
